# The `TFootr` Package <a href="https://github.com/Cassinic/TFootr/"><img src="../man/figure/logo.png" alt="TFootr logo" style="border:none" align="right" height="182.25"></a>


## Introduction


The `TFootr` is a very flexible toolbox to interact with other table or figure packages. This document is to provide you with an examples of how to use `TFootr` to add titles and footnotes to the `kable` outputs. 

First, the filename including the file extension and the full path of the spreadsheet which is used to manage titles and foonotes information must be provided.\cr
The title (including subtitles and population if applicable) information is saved in a list after function call to generate header or footers. 

The list of titles or footnotes can be converted into a string by `unlist` function. Or they can be pasted together with desired separator character. \cr It gives users flexibility to keep titles and footnotes in lists, rather than unpack them and convert them into a string. For example, the end user might easily take out specific element of the list, e.g., data source(s), and do unique formatting.

```{r setup}
# Load the necessary libraries
library(TFootr)
library(kableExtra)
library(magrittr)
library(glue)
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
# (to use |> version 4.1.0 of R is required, for lower versions we recommend %>% from magrittr)
``` 

# A Table Without Annotation

```{r}
if(!require('knitr')) {
  install.packages('knitr')
  library('knitr')
}
iris2 <- head(iris)
p <- knitr::kable(iris2, "simple", col.names = gsub("[.]", "_", names(iris)))
p
```
```{r}

# Title and footnote spreadsheet path and filename
filename_with_path <- file.path("../inst/extdata", "sample_titles.xls")

# Obtain title, subtitle, population with one functional call
title_list <- TFootr::tfootr(filename_with_path, "Sheet1", by_value="t_dm", select_type="title")

# Obtain footnotes and ref notes (including program name, run timestamp, data sources) with one functional call
footnotes <- TFootr::tfootr(filename_with_path, "Sheet1", by_value="t_dm", select_type="footr")
paste(footnotes, sep = "\n", collapse = " \n\n ")
```

# Add Title to Table

```{r}
ft <- knitr::kable(iris2, "simple", 
                   caption =  {paste(title_list, sep = "\n", collapse = " \n ")}, 
                   col.names = gsub("[.]", " ", names(iris)))
ft
```

## Examples

### Simple Examples

The above example of using `TFootr` with `Knitr::kable` to generate table outputs.

### Additional Note:

As is the custom to print the program name, run time stamp and data source at the very bottom of the tables.
